name: Cain Blanchard
source: The protagonist, Cain Blanchard, moves to London in hopes of becoming a renowned magus by studying in pallas crepesculum academia. His life took a deadly turn as he discovers to his dismay, that the ancient beast Behemoth shares an immutable bond with him.
